The '''South Beach Boardwalk''' was an area in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Raider's Cove]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]]. It was frequented by the [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] and criminals that inhabited Raider's Cove, including the [[Nova Blades]].
